title: Recovery hold boundary tests don't pin the gates' own predicate or the 100-call median index
outcome: Changing a recovery hold gate back to second_worst or maximum, or changing the median index so exactly 50 slow calls of 100 fail, turns a boundary test red. For example one RecoveryHoldMeasure method used by both gates and the boundary tests, and a 50-versus-51 case at 100 calls.
acceptance: Both hold gates and the boundary tests use one shared predicate, shown by a recorded failing run when the predicate reads a different field
A timing-free case pins 50 versus 51 slow calls of 100
